items.title: Shelf remembers
items.body: Files and screenshots stay on the Shelf after a restart, until you remove them.

items.title: Keyboard all the way
items.body: Open the island with ⌃⌥Space and move through every module without the trackpad.

items.title: Breaks that feel like breaks
items.body: Focus now runs a calm break timer between sessions, and a longer one after four.
